items.summary: BrowserAct approved under New Idea Filter as REUSE_COMPONENT for public-web browser acquisition role only.
items.rationale: Reuses existing CLI/skill instead of building new browser automation.

items.summary: Strictly PUBLIC_WEB_ONLY: no authentication, no forms, no messaging, no purchase, no CAPTCHA bypass; isolated Chrome must be deleted after use.
items.rationale: Safety boundary prevents unauthorized private data access or permanent resource leaks.

items.summary: Approved lightweight file-based coordination (typed mailbox envelopes, append-only JSONL events, ephemeral state).
items.rationale: EXTEND_EXISTING pattern avoiding daemons or distributed schedulers.

items.summary: NO daemon, background scheduler, persistent agent, shared database, or Router authority change allowed. Atomic publication single-filesystem only; Windows junction rejection enforced.
items.rationale: Opinionated Workspace and deep-change invariants prohibit parallel authority.

items.summary: EXP-12 CLEARS deterministic backtest passed 20/20 retrospective cases, but status remains EXPERIMENT.
items.rationale: 100% fit on curated retrospective cases does not prove prospective generalization.

items.summary: deep_change_probability is a deterministic heuristic score, NOT a calibrated statistical probability; prospective pre-registered cases required before operational reliance.
items.rationale: Prevents false precision and premature deployment into production routing.

items.summary: EXP-18 PASS: verified byte-for-byte retrieval (29/29 files) of pinned sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 artifact under primary source loss.
items.rationale: Demonstrated BitTorrent/DHT fallback distribution viability for pinned open-weight models.

items.summary: Optional last-resort fallback path ONLY; mandatory SHA-256 manifest check; DO NOT add production routing, a registry, or seeding infrastructure.
items.rationale: Prevents adding external dependencies or production torrent daemons to MPE.
